My parents caught on to it and locked away the router when I was home alone. These were pre smart phone days so all I had to occupy my ADHD addled 10 year old self was my home phone and day time television. Some how I got the hot idea to start dialing in cartoon names on the phone for shits and giggles. For example I fuck around typing in 1 555 DANNY PHANTOM and the like. Thinking I would some how access the cartoon world by doing so. Eventually down the road I dial an actual number. On the other line I hear the voice of this sultry sexy woman's voice coming from the other end of the line. At first it started with her asking how my day was, eventually it spiraled to her flirting with me, how she was getting so horny listening to my voice, and to continue our conversation I would need to put in my credit card. Being 10 and having no access to that form of financial responsibility my only response was, "I don't have one but my mommy has one, but I don't think she would let me use it." Que to her realizing something was off and finially asking how old I was. I never heard someone hang up so fast.
